unit: orders lost after the customer was told they were placed
note: A failed create answers 200 and the basket is deleted anyway (OrdersApi.cs:157-166; BasketState.cs:107-108): the customer loses the basket and gets no order
If order-processor cannot poll, no order goes on to stock validation, and nothing tells the customer

unit: orders cancelled for stock without notice
note: The stock-rejected cancel raises no event (Order.cs:155-165), so the customer's orders page is never refreshed
Payment is simulated by a flag here; in a real deployment this is revenue not collected

unit: items the customer added that are not in their basket
note: A refused save is logged at Information and answered NotFound (RedisBasketRepository.cs:41; Basket.API Grpc/BasketService.cs:51-54); an add from the web and one from the assistant at once can overwrite each other (BasketState.cs:35, 54)
The basket store has no data volume, unlike the event bus (AppHost Program.cs:8-10), so a restart of it empties every basket, and nothing records that it did
